options.title: Juicero Sold a {fact1} Juicer. Hands Did the Same Job
options.first_line: Juicero sold a {fact1} juicer, and reporters got the same juice out of its packs with their bare hands.
options.first_frame: The Juicero press on a kitchen counter pushing in, its price slamming on a label beside it.

options.title: Juicero's {fact1} Juicer Only Squeezed Its Own Packs
options.first_line: Juicero's juicer cost {fact1}, and it only pressed the company's own sealed juice packs.
options.first_frame: The Juicero logo landing over a row of sealed juice packs, then a cut to the press.

options.title: Two Bare Hands Beat Juicero's Juicer
options.first_line: Two bare hands squeezed as much juice as Juicero's {fact1} machine.
options.first_frame: A pair of hands squeezing a juice pouch over a glass, a red stamp HANDS landing beside the Juicero logo.

why: A and C give away the twist (bare hands did the same job) in the title and first line, while B shows a pricey juicer locked to its own packs and leaves the stranger asking what went wrong, so they have to stay for the answer.
